spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:5:3: command demo: flag "name" sets separator but its type is string — only a list or map takes several values to split into
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:5:3: command demo: flag "labels" sets separator to "=", which already separates each map entry's key from its value
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:5:3: command demo: flag "quoted" sets separator to a double quote, which is how an item that contains the separator is quoted
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:5:3: command demo: env "hosts" sets separator, which applies to flags and arguments only — an env input's list splits on commas and a configuration file writes a list as a list, so there is nothing for it to choose
